title: draw.log.bin and flow.log.bin are byte-identical (same blobs) while their .t1 streams fully diverge
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/draw.log.bin b/goldens/draw.log.bin
index b0756c2..c59addd 100644
Binary files a/goldens/draw.log.bin and b/goldens/draw.log.bin differ
diff --git a/goldens/flow.log.bin b/goldens/flow.log.bin
index b0756c2..c59addd 100644
Binary files a/goldens/flow.log.bin and b/goldens/flow.log.bin differ
-1 d1e9b17b30111ff3
+1 667b12d44ffa2f6a
-1 569ef1649cccebf5
+1 0e11acdc1621e0e8
detail: draw.log.bin and flow.log.bin share identical old blob b0756c2 and new blob c59addd, yet draw.t1 vs flow.t1 have entirely different per-tick hashes (same seed 42, same catalog_hash). One pair looks duplicated or stale.
recommended_fix: Verify whether flow.dem intentionally aliases draw's actions; if not, regenerate flow.log.bin independently and confirm the binary goldens are not copies of each other.

title: Re-bless chunk contains no goldens for the two newly added demos
detail: This chunk re-blesses 9 existing demo goldens (boot, bundle, demolish, demolish_bundle, demolish_node, draw, ecmp, ecmp_cost, flow) but contains no .t1/.t2/.log.bin for the new router_tiers / router_ceiling demos added by this PR.
recommended_fix: Confirm the new demos' goldens exist elsewhere in the PR; if absent, generate them before merge or the demo gate will fail.
